text: ... from the moment I met you, your personality had the most extraordinary in- fluence over me. I was dominated, soul, brain, and power by you. . .. I grew jealous of everyone to whom you spoke. I wanted to have you all to myself. I was only happy when I-was with yon. When you were away from me you were still present in my art. . .. Of course I never let you know anything about this. It would have been impossible.You would not have understood it. I hardly understood it myself.
